description: Delete a webhook endpoint by id. PostFast stops sending to it at once: deliveries still waiting are dropped, and its delivery log and signing secret are deleted with it. To pause an endpoint instead, set active false with update_webhook_endpoint. An id that isn't in this workspace fails with webhook.notFound. Returns { ok: true }. The deletion cannot be undone.
name: delete_webhook_endpoint
title: Delete Webhook Endpoint
